title: Zesty Fermented Thai Chili Nam Prik
description: A fermented, flaky, quick-fix Thai dish that's vegetarian-friendly and easy to make. With only a few ingredients and some patience, you can enjoy this zesty condiment in no time.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the caster sugar, dashi-extract, and 1 tablespoon of water to make a mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat, about 10 minutes.
In the saucepan, add the finely chopped fermented Thai chili peppers and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the sugar mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and let it ferment at room temperature for 1-2 days, or until it reaches your desired level of sourness.
After fermentation, store the nam prik in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
Before serving, give the nam prik a good stir and adjust the seasoning to taste.
Spoon the nam prik onto crackers, toast, or vegetables for a flavorful snack or side dish.
